answer: Ephemeral Assignment Canyon. Each round, a public verifiable random beacon draws a fresh assignment slate over a fixed seat map. A sybil whose slots scatter across the canyon of unfilled seats cannot target peers, since targets are revealed only after the beacon fires, so the attacker must fund and staff every possible seat to guarantee collusion. The knoll of concentration is empty: no seat repeats, capping reuse. Costs scale with seats held per round, and the incoming tide of new randomness each round voids any precomputed placement.
